entityFieldPolicy: All seven full canonical records and18 incident claims read, including external endpoint definitions/INF068 derivation, aliases and empty crosswalks. Scales, mechanisms, timing, measurements, sources, narratives/interactions and missingness retained. No canonical repair.
rdsReview: No Family RDS. External incoming INF-068 is ratio-derived Material Selective-Omission Degree, not a directly manipulated primitive. Denominator/materiality universe/presented-versus-available input and detection/temporal mechanism explicitly audited. No direct RDS effect.
causalGateReview: 17 Driver→Driver STANDARD_CAUSAL and one RDS→Driver HEIGHTENED_CAUSAL (REL-INF-045). Ten primary/eight reused reviews; native INF-F03 claim retained unchanged.

layersConsidered.BIO: Pharmacologic study metacognitive sensitivity versus mean-confidence null; sampling urgency modeled, not direct adequacy. No prescription/identity or BIO pilot work.
layersConsidered.PSY: Confidence feedback, counterargument labels, motivation versus resistance outcomes and perceived adequacy considered.
layersConsidered.SOC: Source-person trust and interpersonal learning versus general epistemic stance; no trust-game equivalence.
layersConsidered.CUL: Authority-based legitimacy community norms versus perceived credibility; no culture-level causal estimate from source cue.
layersConsidered.ENV: Environmental-risk information and school-water scenario studied; narrative about water scarcity not actual environmental exposure.
layersConsidered.INS: Authority credentials, scientific replication disclosure and institutional trust must reach recipient; no mandatory trust inference.
layersConsidered.INF: Argument content/quality, omission, disclosure, warning and feedback; content property and recipient response separate.
layersConsidered.TEC: AI trust/reliability, synthetic faces and interfaces; technical fidelity, source profile and modeled state distinct.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Three bounded message/task identities, all direct effects RN.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Ordinary advice, sharing and feedback: no causal inference from association.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Replication failures/trust news and adverse experiences; event occurrence not consequence proof.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Risk information and setting constraints considered; no supported exact physical direct effect found.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Authority disclosure, validation/reliability procedures; communicated knowledge of change required.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: Reliability/fidelity/feedback interfaces; no exact epistemic-generalization effect retained.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Social learning/trust constructs, not topology or interpersonal tie as scientific edge.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Warnings, countervailing information, feedback and replication disclosures; identity reuse/dedup checked.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Sensitivity/mean-confidence dissociation and decision sampling; no pharmacologic recommendation.

skepticalReview.method: Separate second pass on measurement, null/contrary contrasts, prior-pilot lineage, exact bibliography and causal versus model interpretation.
checks: Gehlbach adequacy measure contains trust/relevance, equivalence margin not fully reconciled; no supported-null shortcut.

Warning before low-involvement appeal can elicit agreement; inoculation package not warning-only effect.
Thought labels assigned after generation cannot be effects on earlier counterarguments.
ETMCQ general stance, source credibility and automation trust not automatically PSY118.
